text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is! Hey, Mo—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Espo! Sorry to keep you waiting. 
...Hm? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...N-Nah. Nothin' at all!! C'mon... let's 
go grab lunch.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Espo-san! We need to talk—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Espo-san? ...Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: !! ...N-No, nothin' at all!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Are you... sure? Your complexion looks—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up!! More importantly, didja need 
somethin' or what?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... Furioso-san was looking for you. 
She said she wanted to thank you for 
helping with the gift.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
She made handmade bracelets based on your 
advice, and the locals back home were 
apparently thrilled with them.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —...A present...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...Mom wasn't wearin' the earmuffs. Even 
though she always wore them whenever she 
went out...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(The gift I gave her back when I was a 
little kid...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Turn your absolute best feelings into a 
proper physical gift! Give your emotions 
your own unique shape!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(The best gift... poured full of my 
feelings...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, talk about rich comin' from me. 
What a joke.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how much feelin' you pour 
into it, someday... the day comes when 
it's all forgotten—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think so? I don't believe 
that's true.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The feelings you hold for someone who's 
always by your side— they never fade away, 
not even for a single second.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because... that's how it is for me, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I know that love doesn't just disappear so 
easily. So it'll definitely be alright! 
Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ring-ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, thank goodness you picked up! ...Are 
you alright? You seemed a bit off 
today..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
N-Nothing! It ain't really a big deal. It 
ain't, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You always wore them! ...What happened to 
them?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Oh. Well, since I wore them for so 
long... I have them displayed in my room 
now."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"After all, it's a precious present you 
gave me... I'd hate it if they broke or 
got ruined."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I'm about to head out, I look at 
them. And then... it fills me with so much 
energy. That's why I want to treasure them 
and keep them safe."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that? ——... Geez... 
really...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. When going down to the cafeteria 
for lunch——

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Delicious! Hey, was there still some of 
this left?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! They just brought out more a moment 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu♪ I'm so glad to see you cheered 
up.
